operate_id.description: Meeting room contact ID. The user ID type passed in needs to be consistent with the value of user_id_type. For information about user IDs, see [User-related ID concepts](https://open.feishu.cn/document/home/user-identity-introduction/introduction).; Note: If the current schedule is created based on the application identity, when adding a meeting room type invitee, you need to specify the contact person of the meeting room through this parameter, and the contact will be displayed in the schedule meeting room information.; Default: empty

description_rich.description: 日程描述（Markdown 富文本）。读日程时保证有描述时此字段有值；仅有纯文本描述时会用该纯文本回填（此时与 description 值相同）

event_id.description: Event ID.; The event ID is returned when creating a event. You can also call the following interface to obtain the ID of a certain calendar.;- [Get event list](https://open.feishu.cn/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/reference/calendar-v4/calendar-event/list);- [Search event](https://open.feishu.cn/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/reference/calendar-v4/calendar-event/search)

description.description: 日程描述（纯文本）。与 description_rich 互斥，二者至多传其一；推荐统一使用 description_rich（Markdown，兼容纯文本且支持富文本）。切勿与 description_rich 同时传，否则接口会报互斥错误。默认值：空，表示不更新该字段

need_notification.description: Whether to send Bot notifications to event invitees when updating the event.; Default value: empty, indicating that the field will not be updated; Optional values are:;- true: send notification;- false: Do not send notifications

start_time.description: Event start time. It will take effect only when it has a value at the same time as end_time

date.description: Specify the start time in days, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format, for example, 2018-09-01.; Note: This parameter cannot be specified at the same time as `timestamp`

timestamp.description: Second-level timestamp refers to the specific start time. For example, 1602504000 means 2020/10/12 20:00:00 (UTC +8 time zone).; Note: This parameter cannot be specified at the same time as `date`

timezone.description: Time zone. Use IANA Time Zone Database standards such as Asia/Shanghai.; - The time zone is fixed to UTC +0 throughout the day;- The non-all-day time zone defaults to Asia/Shanghai

end_time.description: Event end time. It will take effect only when it has a value at the same time as start_time

date.description: Specify the end time in days, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format, for example, 2018-09-01.; Note: This parameter cannot be specified at the same time as `timestamp`

timestamp.description: Second-level timestamp refers to the specific end time. For example, 1602504000 means 2020/10/12 20:00:00 (UTC +8 time zone).; Note: This parameter cannot be specified at the same time as `date`

timezone.description: Time zone. Use IANA Time Zone Database standards such as Asia/Shanghai.; - The time zone is fixed to UTC +0 throughout the day;- The non-all-day time zone defaults to Asia/Shanghai

vchat.description: Video conferencing information. Not passing a value means that the field will not be updated

vc_type.description: Video conferencing type. If video conferencing is not required, `no_meeting` must be passed

options.description: Feishu video conferencing. When this type is selected, other fields in vchat are invalid.
Third-party linked video conferencing. When this type is selected, only the icon_type, description, and meeting_url fields in vchat will take effect.
No video conferencing. When this type is selected, other fields in vchat are invalid.
Feishu Live. This value is for client use, does not support calls via API, and is read-only.
Unknown type. This value is used for client compatibility, does not support API calls, and is read-only.

icon_type.description: The icon type for third-party video conferencing.; Default value: empty, indicating that the field will not be updated

description.description: Third-party video conferencing copywriting.; Default value: empty, indicating that the field will not be updated

meeting_url.description: Video conferencing URL.; Default value: empty, indicating that the field will not be updated

meeting_settings.description: The pre-meeting settings of Feishu Video Conference (VC) must meet all the following conditions:;- Valid when `vc_type` is `vc`.;- Requires editing permissions for event.; Not passing a value means that the field will not be updated

owner_id.description: Set the user ID of the conference owner. The ID type must be consistent with user_id_type.; This parameter must meet all of the following conditions to take effect:;- Apply identity (tenant_access_token) request and operate event on the application calendar.;- The owner can only be set when the event is set to a VC meeting for the first time.;- owner cannot be a non-user identity.;- owner cannot be an external tenant user identity

assign_hosts.description: Specify the moderator by user ID, the ID type needs to be the same as user_id;_type remains consistent.; Note:;- Only the event organizer can designate a host.;- Moderator cannot be a non-user.;- The host cannot be an external tenant user identity.;- When operating events on the app calendar, specifying a host is not allowed

check_in_start_time.description: Event check-in start time.; Note: The check-in start time cannot be greater than or equal to the check-in end time

check_in_end_time.description: Event check-in start time.; Note: The check-in start time cannot be greater than or equal to the check-in end time

description_rich.description: 日程描述，Markdown 富文本（推荐创建/更新日程统一使用本字段）。与纯文本 description 互斥，二者至多传其一，切勿同时传。支持加粗、斜体、下划线（<u>...</u>）、删除线、链接 [文本](url)、标题（# 到 ###，最多三级）、引用（> ）、有序/无序列表、GFM 表格、图片 ![alt](url)。飞书文档 URL 会自动解析为内联文档。注意：图片仅支持传入已上传的图片 URL，本地图片不会自动上传；需要本地图片自动上传请改用 lark-cli calendar +update 快捷命令。默认值：空，表示不更新该字段

description.description: 日程描述（纯文本）。读日程时同时返回 description 与 description_rich，本字段存放纯文本

start_time.description: Search filter items, start time of event search interval. ; Notice: If start_time and end_time are not passed, the default search is for events within the past month

date.description: Specify the start time in days, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format, for example, 2018-09-01.; Note: This parameter cannot be specified at the same time as `timestamp`

timestamp.description: Second-level timestamp refers to the specific start time. For example, 1602504000 means 2020/10/12 20:00:00 (UTC +8 time zone).; Note: This parameter cannot be specified at the same time as `date`

end_time.description: Search filter items, end time of event search interval. ; Notice: If start_time and end_time are not passed, the default search is for events within the past month

date.description: Specify the end time in days, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format, for example, 2018-09-01.; Note: This parameter cannot be specified at the same time as `timestamp`

timestamp.description: Second-level timestamp refers to the specific end time. For example, 1602504000 means 2020/10/12 20:00:00 (UTC +8 time zone).; Note: This parameter cannot be specified at the same time as `date`

timezone.description: Time zone. Use IANA Time Zone Database standards such as Asia/Shanghai.; - The time zone is fixed to UTC +0 throughout the day;- The non-all-day time zone defaults to Asia/Shanghai

description_rich.description: 日程描述（Markdown 富文本）。读日程时保证有描述时此字段有值；仅有纯文本描述时会用该纯文本回填（此时与 description 值相同）

page_token.description: 分页标记，第一次请求不填，表示从头开始遍历；分页查询结果还有更多项时会同时返回新的 page_token，下次遍历可采用该page_token 获取查询结果

user_id_type.description: 此次调用中使用的用户ID的类型

query.description: 搜索关键字，用于模糊查询日程名称。; 注意：如果日程名称包含下划线（_），则必须精准查询。该场景模糊查询可能无法搜索到日程

attendee_user_ids.description: 日程参与人的用户 ID 列表。设置该字段后，被搜索到的日程中至少包含其中一个参与人

attendee_chat_ids.description: 群 ID 列表。设置该字段后，被搜索到的日程中至少包含其中一个群

meeting_room_ids.description: 会议室 ID 列表。设置该字段后，被搜索到的日程中至少包含其中一个会议室

time_range.description: 日程搜索区间的开始时间。不传值时，默认搜索当前时间前后一个周内的日程

display_info.description: 包含日程基本信息的卡片，用户搜索关键词命中的文本片段，使用<h></h>标签包裹标注

meta_data.description: 日程元信息，包含搜索日程的基本数据；更多数据可通过获取日程接口拉取

app_link.description: 日程的 app_link，跳转到具体的某个日程

event_id.description: 日程 ID。后续可通过该 ID 查询、更新或删除日程信息

is_all_day.description: true表示全天日程，默认是非全天日程

page_token.description: 下次请求需要带上的分页标记

list.description: Query availability of the primary calendar

time_min.description: The start time of the query period, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) date_time format.; Note: The time interval between time_min and time_max cannot be more than 90 days

time_max.description: The end time of the query period, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) date_time format.; Note: The time interval between time_min and time_max cannot be more than 90 days

user_id.description: User ID, you need to input an id that matches the query parameter user_id_type. For example, when user_id_type=open_id, you need to input the user's open_id. Refer to [User-related ID concepts](https://open.feishu.cn/document/home/user-identity-introduction/introduction) for understanding user IDs.; Note: Either user_id or room_id needs to be entered. If both are entered at the same time, only user_id will take effect

room_id.description: Meeting room room_id. You can call the [Query Meeting Room List](https://open.feishu.cn/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/reference/vc-v1/room/list) interface or the [Search for Meeting Room](https://open.feishu.cn/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/reference/vc-v1/room/search) interface to get the corresponding meeting room's room_id.; Note: Either user_id or room_id needs to be entered. If both are entered at the same time, only user_id will take effect

include_external_calendar.description: Whether to include the schedule in the bound third-party calendar.; Values：;- true (default value): Include;- false: Do not include

only_busy.description: Whether to only query busy schedule information.; ;Value:;- true (default): Yes, the query results do not include free schedules.;- false: No, the query results include free schedules

freebusy_list.description: List of busy time periods within the requested time interval

start_time.description: Start time of the availability information. The value must be in the same format as specified in the date_time parameter in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339)

end_time.description: End time of the availability information. The value must be in the same format as specified in the date_time parameter in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339)

options.description: The event invitee hasn't replied or a room is being booked.
The event invitee accepted or a room was successfully booked.
The event invitee declined or a room failed to be booked.
The event invitee or room has been removed from the event.
